description: This file 'UtilsgetFileContent.h' contains inline utility functions related to file operations, including reading properties from files, reading entire file contents, checking if a path is a regular file, recursive file search with pattern matching and exclusions, and variable expansion within strings. It serves as a utility header providing generic file and string processing functions used across the project.

methods.name: bool readPropertyFromFile(const char * filename,const string & property,string & propertyValue)
methods.description: Reads a property value from a configuration file, supports recursive expansion if the property value starts with '$'.

methods.name: bool readFileContent(const char * filename,string & content)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks whether a given path points to a regular file.

methods.name: bool searchFilesRec(std::vector<std::string> & pathList,unsigned int currentDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Performs a recursive search for files matching patterns, with exclusions and depth control, storing results in a string.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Initiates recursive file search based on input path, depth parameters, and exclusions.

methods.name: bool ExpandPropertiesInString(const char * input,const char * filePath,string & expandedString)
methods.description: Expands variables within a string by reading their values from a specified property file, supporting string substitution.
